name: ndumo-tours-workspace
description: Ndumo Tours - Full Stack Application (Angular + Express + MySQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd Backend && npm install && cd ../Frontend && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently "cd Backend && npm start" "cd Frontend && ng serve"
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd Backend && npm run dev" "cd Frontend && ng serve"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
